lines.text: Arcana and I head out of the library and eventually arrive at Elysion headquarters.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Oh, wait just a second.
What is it?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I need to take a photo as proof.
Arcana leans against me and pulls out her phone.
I suddenly remember all the photos plastered on the wall in Arcana's room.
... Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: One second. Just gotta access the camera.
I can enter the Forbidden Library as well, right?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: That right. Since you have authorization.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Goodness me, this camera is so slow.
That means I'll be able to remember things for you.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I really ought to get a new ph...

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: What?
Photos are great,
but it's better to have someone else you can depend on.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I... I just take these photos for fun.
You do?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: You don't think selfies are fun?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: They are for me.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I-I mean, I can totally get why someone would get the wrong idea.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: That they'd take me for some tragic heroine or something like that,

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: but... they'd be wrong!

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Anyway.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: You looked really cool a moment ago. Got my heart racing and everything.
*Click*
Once Arcana has configured the settings to her liking, she takes a photo.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Any chance you could smile for me a little bit more?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I want to remember this as a happy moment.
You said you didn't see this as a commemorative thing.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I don't.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: It's just...
*Click click click*

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I just want to have a photo with my favorite commander that I can cherish.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Once my memory is wiped,

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I may be able to remember you helping me regain my memories,

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: but I may forget just how much I like you, and our conversation that we had in the Forbidden Library.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: There we go. That one came out much better.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: There you go again making that face.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: ... Fine.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: If it bothers you that much...
Arcana holds out her pinky finger.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Let's collaborate every once in a while.
Collaborate?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Yeah, as in work together.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: My job is to record things,

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: and it's far better to get the information straight from the source than from reading secondhand reports.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Missions reports are dry as dirt anyway. I don't like reading them.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: When we're inside the Forbidden Library, I'd remember everything.
... Okay.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Promise?
Promise.
I lock my pinky finger with Arcana's.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: You stay put. I'll be back.
After Arcana disappears into the building, I check a message that I received a few moments prior.
I expect a tactical decision.
I follow Arcana into Elysion headquarters.
Upon seeing me enter the office, Ingrid puts down the tablet she was looking at.
Ingri...

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I don't know.
You don't know what I was going to say.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I wasn't fully aware of what state Arcana was in,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: and I'm not aware of what you saw in the secret archive.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I know you have many questions you want to ask, but I can't help you.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: However...
Ingrid stands up and looks out the window.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: If I were to hypothetically talk out loud to myself, I don't think that'd be a problem.
... Well, since I'm already here.
I sit at the table, where some refreshments have been laid out.
Steam rises from the freshly poured cup of hot coffee.
I might as well stay for a few moments.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Do as you like.
How are the Judges connected to the secret archive?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: The Ark is a smaller place than most think.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You often end up meeting someone in one place,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: and then running into them again in another.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It's an awfully small cast of characters. It can get a bit tiresome.
Why are you hiding information about the Goddess Squad?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There are many people out there who want to keep that information safe under lock and key.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: The question is: are their goals all the same?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: For some, perhaps they see that as the best choice.
When you say some...

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There isn't that much information out there on

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: the man who founded the Best Seller Squad.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: The only thing I'm certain of is that

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: there was something that he wanted to hide.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: The same goes for the higher-ups in the Ark.
That could explain why some of the official records don't exactly align with the truth.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You could be right.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Not even I know all the secrets that are hidden there.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: I'm getting tired of talking to myself. I have to get back to work.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: In fact, Arcana's memory wipe should be finished by now.
Already?
Doesn't it usually take a few hours?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It was already complete by the time you got here.
Ingrid taps on the tablet.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There were times when I felt my patience was at its limit,

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: but I must admit that cooperating with Missilis was worth it in the end.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It's afforded us the ability to upgrade our own selective memory wipe technology.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Now it's much faster. Much safer.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: And more tactical.
Again with the tactical talk...

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You ought to be thankful.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: It's thanks to this tactical collaboration that we succeeded in this attempt.
What attempt?

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: You can see for yourself.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: At any rate, there won't be any issues with losing memories going forward.
Somehow I doubt that.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There could always be the one-in-a-million exception.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: However, it's precisely because of that...
Ingrid turns around and looks at me.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: That we need someone to stand by us, and the decisions we make.
... I understand.
I take a sip of the now cold coffee, and get up.
Then I'll be off.
Thank you.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Elysion coffee tastes pretty good, wouldn't you say?
... Yes. Delicious.
I open the door, and am just about to leave when Ingrid calls to me.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Wait just a moment.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: There was something.
What are you talking about?
Ingrid taps on the tablet.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Information on the founder of the Best Seller Squad.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: A signature on an authorization form.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Although it's just an initial.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: O.
I rush out of Elysion headquarters.
Near the main entrance, I spot a shock of familiar aqua-blue hair.
Beside Arcana, there lies an Americano and a cup of lemon tea.
Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Ah! You're not the legendary commander that I've heard about, are you?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I'm a big fan!

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Do you like coffee, by any chance?
I sure do. Thanks.
You're a horrible actor.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: What? I-I'm not acting!
I take the coffee that Arcana offers me.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Where are you coming from?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I told you to stay put.
Sorry. I had a conversation with Ingrid.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Oh, I see.
How's your memory?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Well...
After pondering something for a few moments, Arcana points at me.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I remember

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: you're my favorite commander.
Is that all?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Do I need more?
No. That's enough.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: So, what did you and the Boss talk about?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: It's alright if it's bad news.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I can take it. You of all people should know that.
It's good news. She said that you won't be forgetting as much going forward.
She said the memory wipes will be...
Safer.
More tactical.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Ah, so the collaboration with Missilis yielded some results?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Ugh. Not that word again.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Anyway, it seems the collaboration with Missilis yielded some results?
You knew?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Yes. Boss kept telling me about it. In fact, she told me so many times I thought my ears were gonna fall off.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: I think she wanted to reassure me, even though I kept telling her I was fine.
I see.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: What else?
Huh?

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: There's no way you two talked for as long as you did and only covered that.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: So, what else did you talk about? Something important?
That...
Is a secret, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Huh?
Then again, if I were to talk to myself, I suppose that'd be all right...
I was in a playful mood, so I emulated what Ingrid had done with me. However... my audience wasn't as receptive.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Who talks to themselves in front of someone?!

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: Just tell me. Quickly.
Seems like I'm not the only one
who can keep a secret.

lines.speaker: arcana
lines.text: My lips are sealed! Promise!
For example, the person standing before me, smiling and drinking her lemon tea,
is second to none when it comes to keeping secrets, especially regarding her most noble of missions.
ARCANE ARCHIVE: END
